efficiency.note: a candidate must be predicted to save at least 15% of prompt tokens

capability.note: online on the search set, a deployed candidate may lose at most one task against the incumbent; the judge cannot settle capability and does not pretend to

budget.note: three runs per search task, three per held-out task, when a round deploys

revision.reason: version 4 accepted a deployment on one run per task, and the first policy deployed under it did not survive repeats
revision.evidence: round 9 read -3.4% on the search set from single runs; with three runs per task the same policy reads +4.0% overall and no transfer, with per-task spreads of 34% and 91% of the baseline
revision.unchanged: min_predicted_saving 0.15, max_tasks_lost 1, min_decision_replayable 0.5, the online path, the trajectory rule

unjudgeable_path.note: when the judge cannot replay a candidate's decisions, the candidate may be measured online on the search set inside the round budget; its efficiency claim then rests on that measurement and is labelled as such, never on a replay estimate

evidence.note: a replay verdict needs the judge to have replayed at least half of the candidate's decisions; below that the judge abstains and the online path decides instead

trajectory_changes.note: a policy that changes what the agent is shown or how long it may run does not just change a prompt, it changes the trajectory. Replay covers aligned steps, and a candidate like that produces fewer aligned steps in reality than the estimate assumed, so the estimate is an estimate about a trajectory that no longer exists
trajectory_changes.requirement: such a candidate is measured online on the search set before it may be deployed, whatever its replay coverage

repeats.note: a saving is a claim about a distribution. One run per task cannot separate a three percent saving from variance, and the spread across runs of one policy reached 90% of the baseline here, so every online claim is averaged over at least this many runs per task

reasons: 5/5 steps diverge: the model's decisions there are NOT replayable (abstain)
6/6 steps diverge: the model's decisions there are NOT replayable (abstain)

evidence: online measurement: the judge could not replay this candidate's decisions, so its efficiency is what running it actually cost
recovered: the original round-11 run was killed by a command timeout after the online measurement was paid for; this record is rebuilt from the recorded runs, and the verdict's estimate was recomputed
outcome: deployed and within capability tolerance; deployed on its online measurement, not on a judged estimate
